items.title: Post debunking 3 months free mobile recharge claim
items.snippet_en: PIB Fact Check stated that the claim alleging PM Narendra Modi is offering 3 months of free mobile recharge to all Indian users is fake. It clarified that no such scheme is run by the Government of India, warning citizens against malicious links.

items.title: PM Modi offering 3 months of free mobile recharge? PIB Fact Check debunks viral claim - Check details
items.snippet_en: The report highlights an online scam claiming PM Modi offers 3 months of free recharge across major telecom networks. It confirms the Prime Minister and government have no connection to the scheme, noting the fraudulent links are designed for phishing and data theft.

items.title: PM मोदी के नाम से 3 महीने के फ्री मोबाइल रिचार्ज का दावा वायरल है
items.snippet_en: TV9 Hindi reported that claims stating PM Modi is providing 3 months of free mobile recharge to Indian users are false. The government has initiated no such scheme, and users are warned against deceptive messages and phishing links.

items.title: Fact Check: Is PM Modi Giving 3 Months Free Recharge To Celebrate 2024 Election Win?
items.snippet_en: A fact-check into social media claims found that no scheme offering 3 months of free recharge was ever announced by PM Modi. It cited alerts explaining that circulating links lead to fraudulent websites used by cybercriminals to collect personal data.

outputs.notes_en: All sources confirm that no such 3-month free recharge scheme exists and that the viral messages are fraudulent phishing scams.
